programme.desc: 以三段式靈異故事接合成的有客到,故事以殯儀業為背景

programme.title: 黑獄斷腸歌之砌生豬肉粵普
programme.desc: 六十年代的香港,警隊貪污嚴重記者程安,在文章爆警察貪污內幕,得罪了華探張耀祖,祖砌安生豬肉,令安含冤入獄監獄的保安主任常以殘酷手段對付不服從的人安真相寫成專稿,偷運出獄外爆大鑊,安從此成了眾人心目中的大英雄

programme.title: 八兩金粵普
programme.desc: 劇情主要描述偷渡美國達16年之久的計程車司機八兩金爲衣錦還鄉,向親友借了八兩金飾,不料回到家鄉汕頭後,發現家人已搬去臺山於是讓童年時的死對頭烏嘴婆及其弟一起赴臺山,途中烏嘴不負盛名

programme.title: 昨日的美食日
programme.desc: 律師筧史朗和髮型師矢吹賢二是一對同居戀人,對他們來說在餐桌一邊享用美食,一邊分享生活瑣事和想法,是最珍貴的日常在史朗的提議下,兩人一同前往京都為賢二慶祝生日,然而在這趟京都之旅後,兩人內心竟有了沒法對對方坦白的事情 某日史朗加班後,竟在商店街撞見賢二與陌生的年輕帥哥並肩而行!與此同時,他的好友小日向大策因同居戀人井上航突然失去蹤影,而尋求協助 原本平靜和煦的日子,突然起了變化!

programme.title: 驚魂遊戲普
programme.desc: 電子遊戲策劃美琪(莫小棋 飾)最近與男友鄭明(胡兵 飾)的感情出現了危機,她對工作心不在焉並懷疑遭到了男友的跟蹤在上司的建議下,美琪與鄭明,以及好友阿森和yoyo前往海島度假

programme.title: 殺手再培訓粵普
programme.desc: 外地殺手入侵本地市場使得一班資深的本地殺手紛紛退隱以示不滿,殺手阿典乘時下定決心轉行和結婚,兩年後阿典仍未能找到合適的工作,但待產的妻子卻執意要在私立醫院生產,故阿典要找高薪厚職的壓力就更重了

programme.title: 喜愛夜蒲 2粵普
programme.desc: 燈紅酒綠的蘭桂坊每夜都會上映一幕幕各式各樣的激情故事,這一晚亦不例外任職影樓助手的攝影師在一個派對中結識了剛與富二代分手的富家女; 廣告仔拿錯了美女人妻的手機; 股票行業務助跟班認識到私鐘妹, 逐漸由憐生愛; 負責在這裡一帶巡邏的差佬碰上任職夜店的女DJ,成為了一對熟識的陌生人

programme.title: 致命替身普
programme.desc: 北漂女孩應佳懷著當明星的夢想,在這座城市里靠跑劇組來尋找演戲的機會半個月沒有接到戲的她,在接到某劇組試戲通知後,跟隨副導一同驅車前往郊外的藝術顧問那裡試戲試戲結束,就在他們準備回去的時候,車子卻意外出了故障無奈之下,應佳只能在郊外暫宿一晚

programme.title: The Windmill Massacre
programme.desc: Jennifer參加了一個探索荷蘭著名風車的旅行團。在途中,旅遊巴發生故障,迫使他們住進一所陰森的小屋,附近更有座可怕的風車。當部分團友突然離奇失蹤時,Jennifer發現他們之間隱藏著一個共同的秘密

programme.title: 密室逃生
programme.desc: 三位網紅相約前往荒島直播旅行,途中遭一名神秘老婦誘騙至偏遠孤島。原來這是一場精心策劃的陷阱,她們竟成了老婦為傷殘孫兒物色新娘的獵物。面對日益瘋狂的囚禁與威脅,她們必須爭分奪秒逃離這座噩夢孤島。

programme.title: 冥婚
programme.desc: 攝影師陳志成長年被一名「紅衣女子」糾纏,導致多位親人慘死;甚至連自己心儀的女孩思桐亦難逃惡運。志成欲尋找思桐慘死的真相,卻揭發關於一場「冥婚」的秘密

programme.title: The Spore
programme.desc: 全球暖化解凍遠古冰層,釋出一股邪惡孢子,為人類帶來毀滅浩劫。逃難中的Meadow躲進一間廢棄小屋,卻發現自己並非孤身一人。她必須與其他倖存者並肩求生,因為感染者正蛻變為饑渴的獵人,對活人展開殘酷獵殺。

programme.title: 煞面迷影
programme.desc: 當年輕母親為女兒莫名失蹤而苦惱時,一連串怪異的事件接踵而至。這都可能與二十年前的意外亡魂為復仇歸來有關…

programme.desc: 當年輕的Evie在海灘上發現一條受詛咒的項鍊時,她並未察覺其中隱藏的邪惡力量。隨著項鍊的暗黑力量逐漸侵蝕她的意志,她無意中喚醒了恐怖的水魔,而這個水魔將威脅到她和她所愛之人的性命。

programme.title: 開棺
programme.desc: 消失三年的鬼手及其盜墓團夥重現江城,再次下墓摸金。怎料四名盜墓賊在開棺時遇驚魂邪煞,逃離後又接連慘死家中。最終古墓屍毒和針孔成為留給員警沈春合僅有的線索,看似普通的盜墓案,瞬間撲朔迷離疑點重重。

programme.title: The Ice Cream Truck
programme.desc: 瑪莉因丈夫工作上的調遷,搬回位於郊區的家鄉。當瑪莉在新房子等候丈夫的時候,一個霜淇淋車殺手已把她視為下一個要殺掉的目標人物。此刻,瑪莉發覺家鄉已不如昔日般平靜安寧…

programme.desc: 跟朋友在酒吧喝酒的女孩邂逅恐怖小說家,兩人一見鍾情感情迅速升溫。原來女孩已悄然落入驚天迷局,全因小說家的前女友是個毀容的女鬼,她借用人面還魂復仇,與前男友聯手開啟奪命驚嚇。

programme.title: 模範家庭 #1
programme.desc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開

programme.title: Room For Rent
programme.desc: 寂寞的寡婦Joyce瘋狂迷戀年輕的新租客。渴望得到愛情的她,為追求幸福,不惜排除感情路上的一切障礙,甚至要殺人滅口也在所不計!因而展開了一個令人毛骨悚然的迷戀故事 …

programme.title: Mulu Nakru (The Masters Face)
programme.desc: 建築師May與男友Gun搬入新居後,驟聞繼母離奇身亡。May收留孤苦的繼妹Noon,怎料她入宅後竟行為詭異,頻遭惡靈附身,而May也陷入恐怖幻象與嚴重失眠的折磨。隨著宅內黑暗秘密逐步揭開,通靈法師終於

programme.title: 替身紙人
programme.desc: 警方在調查一宗團夥殺人案時,突然又發生了離奇的紙人殺人事件,嫌疑人一個接一個被殺。隨著不斷挖出的線索,警方最終發現這背後隱藏著橫跨兩代人的秘密與悲劇。

programme.title: 狄仁傑之通天謎案
programme.desc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。

programme.title: Red Rain (AKA Love Rain)
programme.desc: 故事改編自真實事件,一位專門研究外星人和外星生物的年輕科學家,決心要揭開喀拉拉邦連串怪異事件背後的謎團。

programme.title: 模範家庭 #2
programme.desc: 一個單親媽媽郁香和她的女兒童童搬進了一個住宅區展開新生活。區內住著一個個看似幸福美滿的家庭,背後卻藏著許多不為人知的秘密,而人性的黑暗面亦一步步被揭開

programme.title: Tear Us Apart
programme.desc: 幼女離奇失蹤後,悲痛的Drew與Helen在治療師安排下,前往偏遠林中小屋接受深度諮商。隨著孤立與壓抑逐漸侵蝕理智,療癒之旅化為噩夢。Helen飽受詭異幻象與異象困擾,逐漸分不清現實與幻覺,心智瀕臨崩

programme.title: Red Snow
programme.desc: Olivia是位出色的吸血鬼言情小說作家,一直渴望遇到真正的吸血鬼。當吸血鬼Luke出現在Olivia位於雪地的偏僻小屋向她求助時,她的夢想終於成真。然而,當Luke的吸血鬼同伴在平安夜那天追捕他時,

programme.title: 見怪
programme.desc: 失明的游己任在離島的工廠工作。一天,因颶風的破壞,工廠與外界隔絕。此時突然有一隻怪物來襲,任何看到怪物的人都會化成黑影。因游己任看不見怪物,他能成功協助夥伴安全離開,更奮戰反擊,誓要殺死怪物!

programme.title: 狄仁傑之通天謎案
programme.desc: 狄仁傑﻿捲入一宗震撼大唐的連環命案,兇手以「七宗罪」為名,自詡正義,試圖為其扭曲的道德觀辯護。在他不懈追尋真相的過程中,狄仁傑揭開了偽正義的面具,暴露了潛藏背後的黑暗真相。

programme.title: 鳳飛飛
programme.desc: 鳳飛飛為報姊仇,發現兇手竟為未來夫婿金連白,不知所措。而殺姊夫之兇手蕭豹與梁霸為除後患,與金夫人聯手對付飛飛,欲滅絕鳳家。飛飛怒不可遏,合父母之力將惡贼擊斃。

programme.title: 七仙女
programme.desc: 故事描述少年董永賣身傳員外家,為奴以埋父骨;其孝心感動了七仙女,便幻成村姑,在六位仙姐下凡暗助下,為董縮減償還工作日,回復自由後,二人回董故家,但愉快的凡間生活能持續多久呢?

programme.title: 妖魂
programme.desc: 盛傳很多武林中人在一夜間離奇消失,機智少俠欲查明真相,怎料當他發現原來是妖魂作怪時,他自己亦已身陷險境

programme.title: 死角
programme.desc: 故事描述,狄龍與姜大衛游車河時,遇富家女李菁的跑車拋錨,狄載她返家,一見鍾情。後李往姜之修車廠取車,再遇狄,狄約李去跳舞,夜總會中,碰見李兄陳鴻烈,陳不喜歡狄,故二人只好提早離去;歸家途中,目擊員警追捕逃犯,逃犯掉下之手槍,被狄檢到,從此改變他的命?

programme.title: 新獨臂刀
programme.desc: 姜大衛飾演一個寧願自廢右臂退出江湖,也不願委屈求全的大俠,一直過著隱姓埋名的生活。直到至愛被綁架,好兄弟被殺害,他誓要重出江湖與惡勢力一戰。

programme.title: 豪客
programme.desc: 陸虎出獄後,發現自己原來是被陰險的弟弟陸彪所陷害,更奪去家族煤礦生意。妹妹欲阻止陸彪,反被他監禁起來。陸虎救出妹妹後,發現煤礦已被日本幫派所奪,他們誓要打敗日本人取回煤礦。

programme.title: 獵魔者
programme.desc: 巨富之女賀盈聘請羅力到柬埔寨,從殺手乃汶處奪回商業秘密錄音帶。羅與好友組織一支敢死隊,直赴游擊隊基地,成功將錄音帶交到賀手上後,方發現背後原來有極大的密秘

programme.title: 魚美人
programme.desc: 張珍與金寵之女牡丹早有婚約,金寵卻欲退婚。張珍偶遇化身金牡丹樣子的鯉魚精,兩人漸生情愫。一天,金寵請包公來公斷兩個真假牡丹,包公為成全二人,推辭此案…

programme.title: 壁虎
programme.desc: 為要對付一名貪污的總警司,屢犯竊案的大賊「壁虎」,預告將在富翁的宴會中盜取鑽石。後來被總警司的孫女揭穿他真正的身份,原來是個正義凜然的年青員警。

programme.title: 山歌戀
programme.desc: 牧羊女古秀秀喜唱山歌,父親嗜賭如命;青年劉大龍與秀對唱山歌,情愫互生。曾老虎以追債要脅古老頭許婚;劉欲酬錢替秀父還債。怎知帆船歸來而劉卻失蹤!秀無奈答允出嫁

programme.title: 紅辣椒
programme.desc: 群贼對梅家莊藏金垂涎,但屢劫不果,損失重大。梅逢春為救村滅?瑵撊胭寨探明路徑後通知官府。紅辣椒為寨主千金,遇梅後生好感。梅憑紅協助,將機密繪成地圖送走。惜梅身份敗露,幸官兵趕至…

programme.title: 星際鈍胎
programme.desc: 美麗但無知的李天珍被外星人捉上飛碟,事後無人相信她曾與外星人接觸。於是,當她打算一死以示清白之際,卻遇上同有輕生念頭的失敗私家偵探伊電。二人互吐心聲後改變主意,卻遭遇一連串奇遇,而二人的愛情故事也因此開始。

programme.title: 布衣神相
programme.desc: 東瀛甲派忍者血洗武當,並命人污衊於無敵門掌門獨孤無敵。雲飛揚練成天蠶神功後,決意為武當報仇,挑戰獨孤無敵,但卻被打敗至重傷。幸得布衣神相李布衣所助,傷患得以復原,才能逃避忍者的追殺。

programme.title: 楊乃武與小白菜
programme.desc: 劇情講述,知縣之子劉子和,垂涎葛小大之妻小白菜,用迷藥將其姦污。劉子和事後恐東窗事發,用砒霜毒死葛小大。葛死後,鎮內流言四起,知縣為救愛兒,設計嫁禍小白菜婚前戀人楊乃武。乃武被苦打成招,其姊楊淑英不忍見弟含冤而死,到刑部要求翻案……

programme.title: 鬼新娘
programme.desc: 方明在趕路途中邂逅神秘年輕女子冷秋屏,兩人情投意合並私訂終身。婚後方明驚覺妻子竟是受邪靈操控、被迫吸取男子精氣的亡魂,但冷秋屏因真情不忍加害。最終在道士相助下,方明擊敗邪靈救出愛妻,然而人鬼殊途,兩人於晨光中淒然訣別,冷秋屏含淚投胎轉世。

programme.title: 霹靂十傑
programme.desc: 本片是少林三部作的第三部。劉家輝仍飾演三德和尚,為要保護自持功夫了得便與大清高手結怨的少年英雄方世玉,差點也令少林寺陷入險境。

programme.title: 暗渠
programme.desc: 故事講述偵緝警長趙敬才因一次行動,連累下屬被劫匪擊斃,而被上司指責處事魯莽,改派督察邱正明接辦案件。敬才與正明辦案作風迥異,衝突日多。職業殺手利子健受雇來港狙殺殷商徐文,豈料行動時卻誤中副車,僅殺死徐文之助手;當徐文查得殺手為子健後,急欲除之。警方接獲線報,即派正明與敬才率隊出發,阻止黑幫火拼……

programme.title: 書劍恩仇錄
programme.desc: 乾隆原來並非皇位繼承人,而在出生時被調包,但他一直被蒙在鼓裡,直至地下組織紅花會的人相告。而紅花會總舵主陳家洛是其同胞兄弟。兩弟兄因身世和利益必需身不由己地彼此對抗…

programme.title: 怒海情仇
programme.desc: 故事描述,青年漁夫魯金虎與漁女小玉自幼相好;土豪獨子耀祖,垂涎小玉美色,時藉故親近;一天耀祖欺負寡婦五嫂,金虎抱不平,幾動武,惹小玉誤會金虎與五嫂有不尋常關係…

programme.title: 武林聖火令
programme.desc: 尹天仇的父母因一對武林聖火令﻿遭人暗算身亡,他和妹妹分別被忠奸兩派收養撫育,兄妹各持一半聖火令,習得絕世武功。起初兩人勢同水火,卻在揭開身世秘密後攜手合作,共同為父母報仇雪恨。

programme.title: 女秀才
programme.desc: 聞蜚蛾自幼女扮男裝從父習武,後更考得秀才功名,堪稱文武全才。同窗好友杜子中與魏撰之雖與蜚蛾日夕相對,均不知其是女兒身。聞母見女兒年紀不小,不該再扮男裝,勸蜚蛾選撰之或子中為夫婿。不料蜚娥與二人情誼相同,一時無法抉擇,遂決定由天定奪,怎知陰差陽錯,選婿之箭落於撰之手中。蜚娥後悔不已,才知自己意屬子中…

programme.title: 浣花洗劍
programme.desc: 太湖決戰前夕,白水宮主人被東瀛劍客所傷。於是,他囑咐其弟寶玉代尋找解藥。途中寶玉偶遇關外的小公主,二人一見鍾情。但原來小公主的背後卻隱藏著一個重大陰謀…

programme.title: 乾隆下江南
programme.desc: 乾隆為體察民情,撇下侍衛假扮商人微服出訪江南,期間得知衙門有貪官欺壓百姓,導致民不聊生。這時乾隆遇上一名清廉的賣菜青年,二人合力教訓貪官一頓。最後,青年更被獲封為皇帝的近身侍衛。

programme.title: 雙俠
programme.desc: 宋朝康王被困於金營巨宅,四周被武林高手嚴密看守。兩名身懷絕技的義士必須克服重重困難,完成看似不可能的任務,設法救出康王。

programme.title: 雲泥
programme.desc: 女主角熊素素因不能接受機師男友意外身亡而患上精神分裂症,一天巧遇留學歸來的精神科醫生黎易非,多次奇幻的相遇令易非和素素捲入三角戀和複雜的內心糾結之中。

programme.title: 雜技亡命隊
programme.desc: 故事描述,土匪出身的軍人韓佩昌發動叛變,殺死師長楊宗,竊居其位,楊家只得長子大英一人逃出生天。大英志切報仇,結果未得手已告命喪;其好友陳風、梁國仁、傅全義、辛成決替其復仇…

programme.title: 野姑娘
programme.desc: 金小芳是一位活潑且無畏的鄉村少女,面對惡霸從不退縮,總是勇敢反抗。當她揭露了唐家大少爺的陰謀後,立刻引來他的狠毒報復。幸好,她心儀的男子大海及時挺身而出相救。兩人能否攜手對抗險惡命運,改寫結局?

programme.title: 沒有老公的日子
programme.desc: 黃太太獨力撫養兒子Alex成人,與媳婦阿彤一起生活。豈料Alex意外逝世,死前道出外遇女友黑仔已懷有身孕。結果三名沒有老公的女人同住一室

programme.title: 仙女下凡
programme.desc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活,某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港。初到人間的她人生地不熟,險遭不法之徒欺騙,幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救。面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼,七妹屢施法術相助,卻屢遭誤解為妖魅。兩人在困境中互相扶持,情愫漸生,共同守護孤兒院的未來。

programme.title: 仙女下凡
programme.desc: 天宮仙女七妹嚮往凡間生活,某夜偷駕祥雲下凡來到香港。初到人間的她人生地不熟,險遭不法之徒欺騙,幸得經營負債累累孤兒院的董自立相救。面對貪婪富商覬覦院址、步步緊逼,七妹屢施法術相助,卻屢遭誤解為妖魅。兩人在困境中互相扶持,情愫漸生,共同守護孤兒院的未來。

programme.title: 血芙蓉
programme.desc: 故事描述清帝雍正為了鞏固統治地位,組織了一暗殺集團「血滴子」,為他殺害異見分子。時有一清廷侍衛統領韓天德者,因不值雍正所為而遭殺害,幸其妻容秋燕適不在家,幸免於難,容悲憤莫名,獨闖「血滴子」統領金罡風家,為夫報仇,終行刺失敗而回。後得棄暗投明之前「血滴子」成員馬騰及其師弟王俊相助,合三人之力終將金罡

programme.title: 獨臂刀王
programme.desc: 獨臂刀方剛與妻子二人息隱歸田,但當方剛的妻子被擄走,他唯有被迫重出江湖對付武林惡黨「八大刀王」,以救回妻子。

programme.title: 花月良宵
programme.desc: 魔術師陳子新和歌女張曉萍一次避雨,誤闖豪華大宅,曉萍被屋主以爲她是失散孫女,對她甚爲喜愛,可是引起富豪外甥不忿,設計害子新和曉萍。萍將計就計,把陰谋揭發,成功成立了歌舞團。

programme.title: 唐山五虎
programme.desc: 一位功夫師傅與三位門徒被惡霸欺淩,師徒俱敗於他拳下。三徒悲憤填膺,分別尋師學藝。半年後,惡霸壽辰之日,三徒連袂回歸,誓要與惡霸一較高下!

programme.title: 王昭君
programme.desc: 王昭君拒絕賄賂畫師,於是一直被畫師畫醜致未被皇帝看上。但皇帝初遇昭君後,驚為天人,即選中她。畫師被逐後,為報復而設計將昭君與匈奴可汗和親。皇帝因拒絕婚事即引來兩國爭戰,以致王昭君最後為了平息戰亂不得不犧牲自己。

programme.title: 七俠五義
programme.desc: 太師之子在陳州貪贓枉法,私吞皇糧,被包拯當場斬首處死。太師知道後大怒,並令人刺殺包拯,幸得展昭及時阻止,救回他一命。皇上的珍品被偷的同時,宮中又發生謀殺案,於是,皇上限定包拯要在十天內破案。展昭馬上出發搜捕兇手。包拯和展昭最後可否如期破案?

programme.title: 阿牛入城記

programme.title: 少北宗師

programme.title: 挺進中原

programme.title: 津門奇案之開槍

programme.desc: 安斯利前往冰島雷克雅未克,發現一種真心刺激的傳統和現代美食他用大蒜牛油烹調經典的挪威龍蝦,還有醃三文魚和檸汁魚生,麥芽麵包和在間歇泉中焗製的蛋糕

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #4
programme.desc: 安斯利的街頭美食長徵於大阪落幕,他在當地發現了製作大阪燒的藝術,有點像用班㦸包裹的英國早餐,嘗試日本風的小食,並製作生蠔天婦羅和辣蝦烏冬

programme.title: 山繆傑克森:給我聽好
programme.desc: 憑藉無出其右的職業道德,山繆傑克森作為電影史上最傑出人物之一的地位毋容置疑這位仍然擄獲全球粉絲的心的漫威演員,一起跟進他的傳奇

programme.title: 李小龍:戰士之道
programme.desc: 李小龍,好萊塢電影的標誌性人物,武術先驅,但最重要的是,他是一位朋友《武者之路》全面審視,由最親近的人講述李小龍的傳奇

programme.title: 夏奇拉:新時代女性
programme.desc: 講述唱片銷量超過1億哥倫比亞出生的超級巨星莎琦拉的故事;還有她堅定不移的倡議和慈善努力,使她成為有類似志向的藝人和粉絲的榜樣

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #2
programme.desc: 腔棘魚通常被稱為恐龍魚,在化石記錄中佔有獨特的地位,近一個世紀前重新發現它時震驚了科學界我們跟隨它的旅程直到今天,陪同 WildOceans 的科學家進行探險,以揭開它們更多的秘密和行為

programme.title: 非洲海洋 #3

programme.desc: 冬天溫和潮濕,對不同動物來說,是好消息,也可以是壞消息歐洲馬鹿被逼移到更高的地方,三文魚已經半年沒有食物,山兔變成了顯眼的白色,松鼠將自己的幼崽趕出巢穴

programme.title: 電腦遊戲:電玩的故事
programme.desc: 《電腦遊戲:電玩的故事》是一部關於電子遊戲歷史的專題紀錄片歷時近 5 年製作,跨越了從技術起源到街機遊戲誕生的時光從《乓》到《食鬼》,《超級瑪利歐》到《盜墓者羅拉》,《毀滅戰士》,《俠盜獵車手》等等,我們編纂有史以來發展最快的新媒體的非凡故事

programme.title: 重機夢想家之基努李維 #1

programme.title: 空中戰士 10 #5

programme.title: Cute Pet At Home
programme.desc: The white cockatoo is one of the more common macaw species, but its number in the wild has gradually declined in recent years Hand-reared white cockatoos love to be close to their owners Their large size is one of their features Like other large macaws, white cockatoos are really loud, but if it's a hand-reared bird raised from a young age, the situation of screaming will be much better If you want to raise a pair of adult birds, it is ideal to keep them in an open area with good sound insulation or without neighbors Their friendly personalities make them one of the more suitable large macaw species as pets

programme.desc: The whole world loves a good curry, and living in New York, Samira loves to make curries, Indian, South East Asian and the Western stew, but she heads back to India where she learns how to make some of India’s finest curries nnHere is the story of ultimate deliciousness -- the tale of the curry The desire to perfect her skills, sets her off on a curry trail, seeking out the best chefs in Delhi and getting them to spill their secrets nnThis episode travels through the kitchens of master chefs, who created the king of all curries, The Butter Chicken, reintroduces the authentic korma, a recipe that has been tweaked across the globe and tells the story of the Raja Mirch, the hottest pepper in the world

programme.title: Inside Maximum Security
programme.desc: 5 hardened criminals, 1 unique prison, in a ground-breaking observational documentary series, that will show you for the first time what prison is really like Changi Prison is a concret purgatory, spartan to the extreme There are no beds, no pillows and no chairs in the cells A shower is done stooping above a toilet hole Humiliating strip searches are routine, as a matter of security Yet, practiced in this prison are some of the most sophisticated methods to reform the hearts and minds of the most reclacitrant prisoners So much so that Singapore's reoffending rates are among the lowest globally Yet even at those low rates, at least 1-in-5 inmates are back in jail within 2 years after their release For the first time ever, six inmates, incarcerated multiple times, agree to reveal their full udentities, for our cameras to capture their lives behind bars, as they unfold Will the regime in jail finally be enough for them to renounce a life of crime? Will this be their final stint in Changi Prison?

programme.title: Outbreak Onboard
programme.desc: Cruise ships gave coronavirus a free ride around the world this Spring While infected passengers think the Ruby Princess should be sailed out to sea and sunk, its owner company is busy marketing post-Covid cruises Far from protecting people, the release of the ship’s passengers onto Australian shores triggered a public health emergency with the Ruby Princess now named as the single largest source of Australia’s coronavirus infections Tracey Temple, a passenger with underlying health conditions, is adamant that Princess Cruises forewent their duty of care “As far as I’m concerned, they never put our safety first” Pleas for information were met with reassurance from staff that “this ship is virus free” The cruise liner was ultimately called back to Sydney, but not before the virus had spread unchecked among the passengers, and unchallenged by social distancing measures Unaware of the public health disaster they were carrying, the passengers then dissipated not only across Australia, but the world “We thought we were going into the problem; we didn’t realise we were the problem,” says another passenger 850 passengers and crew from the ship contracted the virus,and at least 26 died

programme.title: Yasuni Man
programme.desc: A desperate struggle between conservationists and oil interests plays out, as the indigenous people living in the heart of the Ecuadorian Amazon struggle to preserve their way of life against encroaching modernity Filmmaker and biologist Ryan Patrick Killackey documents the staggering biodiversity of the Yasuni region at risk of destruction In the era of impending climate crisis, it's a more urgent story than ever

programme.title: The Neutral Ground
programme.desc: In 2015, CJ Hunt was filming the New Orleans City Council’s vote to remove four confederate monuments from the city A forceful group of critics protested the decision and fearing retaliation, no crew would agree to remove the statues CJ sets out to understand why a losing army from 1865 still holds so much power in America At once funny and furious, this film documents the USA's troubled romance with the Lost Cause

programme.title: Super Senses E5
programme.desc: There are senses we share with most animals, but what about those senses that human is equipped with? Infrared light, electromagnetic waves and ultrasound, are all found within a spectrum of sensory information that just passes by ordinary humans This episode is all about those ‘super human’ senses – animal sensory systems that can detect magnetic fields (magneto- reception), electric fields (electroreception) and infrared radiation

programme.title: 來!為這城禱告
programme.desc: 你們要為那城求平安,為那城禱告耶和華;因為那城得平安,你們也隨著得平安。(耶29:7)

programme.title: 地球深度行V 大地的寶藏
programme.desc: 攝製隊走訪美國、英國、 瑞士、澳洲、土耳其、以色列、埃及、中國及亞洲等國家,訪尋學者專家多年來從大地發掘的寶藏及科研成果,當中包括高山上經歷大洪水形成的奇異化石;全球首卷手抄絲綢中文聖經;以色列鑄造挪亞方舟金幣場等。n一切一切的資料,讓觀眾在欣賞地球的創造同時,見證上帝的奇妙創作及精密設計,從心感受

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 如果還有明天
programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 世界生命之道:鄺保亮牧師
programme.desc: 鄺保亮牧師,與父親鄺健雄牧師一同於新加坡帶領9千多人的教會,承傳父親熱心佈道的精神,繼續以激勵人心的資訊,挑戰我們成為為主擺上的門徒!

programme.title: 一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會
programme.desc: 由「愛基金」主辦、「創世電視」協辦的「一生最美的祝福音樂巡迴佈道會」,聯合不同教會的力量,加上演藝人的見證,將福音帶給香港市民。

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 郭文池牧師 - 給都市人的福音
programme.desc: 人無遠慮必有近憂,都市忙碌的生活,城市人的孤單焦慮隨處可見。究竟都市人在那裡可以找到福音?醫治心靈的良藥在那裡?

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 王良牧牧師- 神蹟醫治
programme.desc: 曾經是中國腫瘤科外科醫生,現在是美國基督工人神學院教牧博士的王良牧牧師,詳細講解什麼是神蹟醫治。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 葛培理牧師特輯
programme.desc: 節目記錄葛培理佈道團最新福音事工,並葛培理牧師70年來佈道的足跡及對世界各地的貢獻,讓我們面對不同的世情,仍然把握機會傳福音。

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 鋼琴大師的生命樂章
programme.desc: 巴哈, 莫劄特, 貝多芬, 蕭邦 - 四位誇越時代的鋼琴大師,在他們的生命樂章裏面,上帝的音符不斷跳動,並且影響後世無數音樂家。國際知名鋼琴家Sandra Wright Shen,曾獲得多個國際鋼琴大賽的冠軍,她將會為我們分享四位鋼琴大師的信仰故事。

programme.desc: 今天,有很多人正面對著生命中突然而至的苦難與罪困,在天災、人禍、病困及罪咎中,有人因為痛苦不堪而選擇輕生,但亦都有人在掙扎過後,生命變得更有焦點,更清晰人生的方向。影音使團製作隊跨越中港台兩地,拍攝對象包括:台灣風災救災者、飽歷風霜的一代影星、蒙古車禍生還者、從死亡邊緣活過來的反派演員、與癌同行的歷

programme.title: 福氣教會講道系列
programme.desc: 如何建立健康強盛的教會? 改變社區可以轉化城市? 作為基督徒,我們又如何盡忠地完成普世宣教使命? 一個「幸福小組」,讓教會續步履行三個使命!由台灣高雄福氣教會牧者主講,從《聖經》的話語開始,一起來學習「幸福」智慧!

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-中華文明起源重溯與聖經創世記的關係
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」

programme.title: 屬靈教室: 郭文池牧師 - 給都市人的福音
programme.desc: 人無遠慮必有近憂,都市忙碌的生活,城市人的孤單焦慮隨處可見。究竟都市人在那裡可以找到福音?醫治心靈的良藥在那裡?

programme.title: 何偉強牧師-廿一世紀的屬靈人
programme.desc: 迷惘、沒有方向、疲乏,面對社會上的各種難題和困境,我們應該怎樣做,才能成為合符上帝心意的人? 何偉強牧師將會一連十三集,透過哥林多前書,與你講述處世之道。

programme.title: 喜樂婆婆會客室
programme.desc: 主持小金子喬媽,人稱「喜樂婆婆」,一生經歷操練出一套喜樂心得,她更請來一眾嘉賓好友,分享人生中大小風浪,靠著的是同出一轍的喜樂秘訣,在節目中娓娓道出那份屬天的快樂。

programme.title: 地球大神祕
programme.desc: 從世界各地蒐集到數以百計奇異事物內容,都是無法以一般人接受的觀點加以解釋,除非這個世界在科學理論上有「超自然」的存在!

programme.title: 《天下華人唱出好詩歌大賽》大賽
programme.desc: 由影音使團、香港福音盛會、華福會香港區委會、以勒基金主辦,創世電視首屆「天下華人唱出好詩歌」大賽,冠軍即將誕生。世上最美的聲音,是生命重生的聲音,世上最美的身影,是逆境前行的身影。500位參加者,一年訓練、成長、比併、同行,要成為祝福城市的好聲音。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#174粵
programme.desc: 悅完成輔警訓練，首次出更時，朋巴結悅的拍檔，悅尷尬。但朋頻頻「偶遇」，令悅大怒，並公事公辦，發告票給遺例泊車的朋。眾人取笑朋太緊張，慶更要朋請眾人吃飯以示懲罰，但這邊廂，情及麗卻在公廁內遇到變態色魔。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#19粵普PG
programme.desc: 黃藥師見陸冠英和程瑤迦情投意合，當場讓他們成親。歐陽克爬出來覓食，吃飽後用陸冠英性命威脅程瑤迦脫衣。歐陽克從傻姑口中發現密室，但反被黃蓉教訓，只好退守。此時穆念慈來到，被歐陽克輕薄，楊康怒而將其殺死。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 凍肉店選擇繁多，可按個人食量購買，肥媽在此買齊一個人晚餐的食材。心形的和牛漢堡扒不難煮，紫薯蓉搓到有雲呢拿味，就要留意肥媽教路。用拳頭般大小的鮑魚炮製鮑魚焗飯，只需二十元？還有「七彩駝鳥絲炒烏冬」。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 社交焦慮症患者害怕接觸社交場景，會出現緊張、驚慌、手震等症狀，影響關係的建立。精神科醫生提出，如將AI聊天機械人用得其所，或有助改善溝通能力，但要注意避免過分依賴，適得其反。戲劇大師毛俊輝受父母薰陶，從小愛上戲劇，成年後遠赴美國學戲，其後留美發展只屬無心插柳？回港參與演藝教學工作，如何將西方文化融入香港？為當話劇團藝術總監，棄任演藝學院院長，有何原因？「睇餸食飯」，陳國賓炮製「鮮淮山醬炒鮮牛肉」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 去珠海吃海鮮，當然要逛水產批發市場。主持選購長腳蟹、生蠔、虎蝦後交予酒樓加工，豪歎海鮮盛宴。深圳可找到滋味牛腩煲，加蒜片、秘製辣醬同吃，味道昇華。走進湖景秀麗的人才公園做瑜伽，可透過無人機服務「空投」外賣，吃喝夠方便！這集「試伏」主題是另類零食，超怡試吃滷香菇前竟一秒激嬲前輩們？回港覓尋新加坡地道風味，海南雞、肉骨茶小火鍋是必食之選。跟三五知己把酒暢聚西式歡樂時光，兼享買一送一美食着數，加倍歡樂！

programme.title: 天梯#5粵
programme.desc: 世章說服愛娣到廣州居住；美娟指保羅當初承諾與世雯結婚後會入贅賀家，堅決反對保羅帶女兒走，新月終說服美娟。苗天被老闆黎濟民賞識，將大查櫃職位預留給他。新月終得知道世章騙過她，原來他與愛娣曾到西樵山遊玩。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 小丸子想籌集三千日圓購買雜誌介紹的奇跡筆，碰巧雜誌懸紅徵求靈異照片，小丸子於是找小玉爸爸幫忙。小渚學芭蕾舞時扭傷腳，小丸子和小玉去家裡探望她，誰知小渚竟要求兩人請花輪同學來探望她。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「文化遺產」泛指有實物可查究的文化傳統資產，名單上不一定只有舊建築，生活中一些常見的食物，也有可能是「非物質文化遺產」！涼茶、雲吞麵、蛋撻、港式奶茶等傳統美食，都在非遺之列。「Kids’ Notes」請來兩位嘉賓，細談相關由來故事與製作技巧，讓小朋友認識更多。此外，大坑舞火龍、舞獅、南音等文化活動，也被納入非遺，嘉賓訴說舞火龍的第一身感受，並即席哼唱一句南音。另播放AI生成動畫《亡羊補牢》。

programme.title: 多啦A夢粵
programme.desc: 大雄從相簿得知媽媽童年曾遺失鑽石戒指，與多啦A夢乘時光機回到過去查明真相，才發現所謂鑽石只是玻璃。大雄借用「地圖注射器」開設速遞公司，卻因操作失誤令貨物送錯地方，引發連串混亂。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
programme.desc: 近期樓市放緩，不過荃灣三房單位，交投逆市上升，樓價有否受惠？區內租務表現又如何？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵 及 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 《2026香港小姐競選》圓滿舉行，冠軍袁絲珩、亞軍鄧匡閔、季軍李澤欣順利誕生。節目除了直擊眾佳麗的第一手賽後感言外，更會送上決賽當晚的台前幕後花絮。攝製隊接到觀眾報料指，馬鞍山個別街坊商場的按摩店，疑似違規經營及非法賣淫。攝製隊發現涉事按摩店門外大多聲稱提供一般美容按摩，以至主打專為女士而設的服務。大律師概述按摩牌照規範及違規罰則；攝製隊更接觸到光顧的男顧客，從中探得更多疑似賣淫內情……

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#16粵
programme.desc: 有「何媽」之稱的文謙對同事照顧周到，范特栖卻認為他刻意討好女同事，對他甚為反感。冠一為某嬰兒品牌的宣傳計劃臨時召開會議，欲聽取身為人父的文謙的意見，要求在家工作的他參與視像會議。文謙表現異常，范特栖發現箇中真相後欲向冠一舉報他偷懶，幸得萬里及時阻止；惟他其後仍伺機告狀，令冠一取消員工在家工作的安排。范特栖與文謙嫌隙加深，更為爭奪某個無關重要的項目展開連番「惡鬥」。最終，文謙卻對范特栖改觀……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#21粵PG
programme.desc: 雪文將發生在自己身上的不如意歸咎幸如，往找幸如晦氣，拉扯間，幸如推跌雪文。雪文送院，並向繼威哭訴。隨後，雪文要狀告幸如……熙妍因家族包袱，只能與浩恩發展地下情。熙妍和浩恩故意到郊外行山，竟跟苓君撞個正着，情急下找來家謙、幸如幫忙掩護。曉彤出席音樂會遇上Edmond，原來二人曾有過一段情，但曉彤為家族和事業狠心與他分手。曉彤對Edmond決絕，哲朗遂利用Edmond設局陷害曉彤……

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#26粵普PG
programme.desc: 貞貞提出離婚，又要脅孩子生父思源讓她擢升；蜜語爭取到雲天集團招標項目，被牛總收買的思源利誘貞貞在Marcos房間裝竊聽器，蜜語為Marcos在房間擺放絹花；招標會期間Marcos團隊發現竊聽器，蜜語手機與竊聽器配對成功

programme.title: 玄戰粵PG
programme.desc: 黑先知們的初戰展開，「高感直覺組」的「幻月婆婆」、「靈力皇后」June、「山風GPS」阿嵐、「暗黑使者」Noa先行比拼。四人將接受兩回合的預測考核，由堪輿學家麥玲玲、「高維感應師」徐加晴、「魔法塔羅師」Jan Jan評分。這集結束後兩人可晉級，剩下的則要落入「結界區」。嘉賓陳展鵬現身，出題考問四位黑先知。經過一輪算計感應，誰人最能命中展鵬心底的答案？節目組還安排四人外出，予以更玄幻的靈力考驗……

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
再創世紀#34粵PG
programme.desc: 敬賢發現學禮一直在利用自己，父子反目。學禮以為可以阻止屈奇頓參與烏托邦計劃，豈料屈奇頓已被烏托邦收購。所有環保概念股創新高，全民陷入瘋狂泡沫中。澤雨為了定垚決定退出烏托邦，轉而投資程凱的超級電池。高哲分析需結合生態村概念，才能擴大超級電池的發展價值。此時彼列基金打算將思妤工作的生態村上市，思妤再次誤會高哲。定垚工作至深夜，澤雨前來探望並乘機求婚，定垚說要有鮮花才肯應允，澤雨滿心歡喜去買花，誰料到…

programme.desc: 去珠海吃海鮮，當然要逛水產批發市場。主持選購長腳蟹、生蠔、虎蝦後交予酒樓加工，豪歎海鮮盛宴。深圳可找到滋味牛腩煲，加蒜片、秘製辣醬同吃，味道昇華。走進湖景秀麗的人才公園做瑜伽，可透過無人機服務「空投」外賣，吃喝夠方便！這集「試伏」主題是另類零食，超怡試吃滷香菇前竟一秒激嬲前輩們？回港覓尋新加坡地道風味，海南雞、肉骨茶小火鍋是必食之選。跟三五知己把酒暢聚西式歡樂時光，兼享買一送一美食着數，加倍歡樂！

programme.title: 天梯#5粵
programme.desc: 世章說服愛娣到廣州居住；美娟指保羅當初承諾與世雯結婚後會入贅賀家，堅決反對保羅帶女兒走，新月終說服美娟。苗天被老闆黎濟民賞識，將大查櫃職位預留給他。新月終得知道世章騙過她，原來他與愛娣曾到西樵山遊玩。

programme.title: 高朋滿座#174粵
programme.desc: 悅完成輔警訓練，首次出更時，朋巴結悅的拍檔，悅尷尬。但朋頻頻「偶遇」，令悅大怒，並公事公辦，發告票給遺例泊車的朋。眾人取笑朋太緊張，慶更要朋請眾人吃飯以示懲罰，但這邊廂，情及麗卻在公廁內遇到變態色魔。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#19粵普PG
programme.desc: 黃藥師見陸冠英和程瑤迦情投意合，當場讓他們成親。歐陽克爬出來覓食，吃飽後用陸冠英性命威脅程瑤迦脫衣。歐陽克從傻姑口中發現密室，但反被黃蓉教訓，只好退守。此時穆念慈來到，被歐陽克輕薄，楊康怒而將其殺死。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
高朋滿座#175粵
programme.desc: 溢與義欲到日本旅行，二人拆利是時，義發現每年家人在利是上「厚此薄彼」。溢向家人提起日本之行，眾長輩集資助他。義提出欲同行卻遭反對，一怒之下連飯也不吃，立即回房。義有感慶非常偏心，竟自暴自棄起來。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#20粵普PG
programme.desc: 裘千仞和楊康先後騙全真七子說黃藥師殺害周伯通和郭靖，梅超風不敵七子，歐陽鋒殺譚處端，梅超風護黃藥師而受傷…郭靖現身救與黃藥師對戰的江南六怪，黃藥師為他療傷後帶傻姑回桃花島，郭靖和黃蓉要去岳州找打狗棒。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 日本興起的「可樂餅」是炸薯餅，想食可樂味的「可樂餅」，肥媽自創煮法。肥媽的印尼式「番茄炒蛋」味道層次豐富，六號如何用印尼口音調戲雜貨店姐姐？還有「銀芽炒魷魚仔」和「芥菜鹹蛋肉片湯」，三餸一湯輕易完成。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 夏秋交替之際，若想利用鮮花為家居增添一份秋日氣息，如何挑選？此外，到來的花道教授亦會分享花卉作品，還即場示範製作精緻的「鮮花風鈴」。風鈴隨風擺動，為家中更添浪漫秋意。這次「跟大廚去搵食」，李偉強師傅帶領大王、菲比一同探索正宗韓式滋味。店內的韓式炸雞選用韓國走地雞炮製，肉嫩多汁，還有「醬豬蹄」、「水冷麵」、「八爪魚煎餅」等，都是地道的韓國美食。「睇餸食飯」環節，三姐炮製「皺皮椒菜脯炒腩片」。

programme.title: 吃貨橫掃港深珠粵
programme.desc: 吃貨們要試澳門葡式口味，竟錯往珠海橫琴？原來是價錢作怪！豬扒包、焗豬扒飯與咖喱牛腩飯等澳葡美食、各有滋味秘訣。深圳潮汕菜食店內，食材船盛載多種即日海鮮讓顧客自選，每道菜式配以不同醬汁，為水產再提鮮！主持亦有隱世茶室推介，放鬆寫意度過下午。留港覓食，繼續有驚喜優惠。以花為主題的火鍋套餐，牛肉、特飲賣相精緻，額外加購七色丸子及餃子，更添口腹滿足感！另外，粥麵點心餐廳提供本地情懷套餐，人均不需百元。

programme.title: 天梯#6粵
programme.desc: 世雯出嫁時，新月懷疑丈夫不忠而忘記帶思行找世雯，幸得苗天協助讓世雯摸了牙縫。世章定讓世豪出任大查櫃，遭坤堯反對。新月發現愛娣住處，逼愛娣即時離開廣州。世章胸口劇痛送院，愛娣向新月道出自己與世章的關係。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 夏日炎炎，濱治提議舉行試膽大會，並邀請小丸子參加，小丸子一口答應，但小玉卻因患感冒未能同行。小丸子在電視上看過《福爾摩斯》後，立志成為偵探，並且成功替爺爺解開明信片寄件人之謎。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 四名男生分為曲奇、薯片小兵團，接受「廠長」蚌蚌公主指派的零食廠考驗。在「廠長話」遊戲中，有隊伍全員零失誤過關，順利獲得零食秘笈作獎勵。接着的果園收集任務中，薯片兵團表現亮眼。隊員為了爭分奪秒，甚至不惜手腳並用奮力爬行，最終僅用了不到三十秒，就成功「收集」到五種水果，速度驚人！兩隊於「溶化之橋」遊戲都勇敢挑戰高難度，分別選擇運送五個與六個雪糕球。最終雙方的結算數量僅僅相差一個，成績非常接近。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 古琴妹妹準備去村中教小朋友們絃琴，並順便準備了一些竹筍飯請大家吃。細菌人知道之後，企圖奪取那些竹筍飯。鐵殼小子前往企鵝村派玩具，沿途受到細菌人襲擊，幸好得到小雪人仔出手相助。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 馬百良六寶靈芝呈獻:最強生命線粵
programme.desc: 骨質疏鬆症是一種骨骼新陳代謝的病症，常見於長者，而女性一般在停經後會停止分泌雌激素，因此較男性更容易出現骨質疏鬆的情況。患者因為骨質密度減少，令骨骼結構變得脆弱，因而容易導致骨折、造成痛楚，以及引發其他併發症。值得留意的是，骨質疏鬆並非只是一個「老人病」，年輕女性若長期節食、曬太陽不足以及有家族史，都可能提早出現骨質疏鬆症。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 富途證券特約:富途講美股粵 及 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#17粵
programme.desc: 唐芯開學在即，萬里特意安排各種「開學儀式」，祈求一切順利。原來唐芯小時候每逢開學都會肚痛，全靠萬里給她的「護身符公仔」才能安心上學。開學當天，唐芯因故匆匆出門，忘記帶上公仔；萬里憂心忡忡，趕往香港島大學欲把公仔交給她，卻意外聽到唐芯與盧漢娜的對話，得悉一個她不願接受的事實……萬里原本打算放手，不再刻意監察唐芯的動向；豈料其後察覺唐芯行為有異，調查下驚悉她正參與一項危險活動，遂急忙趕往島大……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#22粵PG
programme.desc: 曉彤暫代東馹主席，但內部勢力蠢蠢欲動，苓君着家謙要加倍支持曉彤。婉蘭向幸如、家謙訴說丈夫出軌，幸如擔心夢裡捉姦遇車禍的命運也會發生在婉蘭身上。幸如在制止婉蘭捉姦時，閃回一段失去的記憶……曉彤苦於處理東馹的千瘡百孔。Edmond為免影響曉彤，毅然辭職……婉蘭積極面對困境，幸如決心拯救婉蘭。繼威被安排協助幸如跟進保險廣告項目，幸如故意刁難他……

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#27粵普
programme.desc: 紀封發現閉路電視影片對蜜語不利，刪除影片以拖延時間，因此被解僱。蜜語愧疚不已，兩人分頭調查，蜜語想起送花瓶途中曾遇到房務員戴蕙，予誠又告訴她貞貞曾與其姐蜜瑤通電話；紀封跟蹤思源，發現他太太與貞貞會面…

programme.title: 玄戰粵PG
programme.desc: 「塔羅占星組」的四位黑先知接力登場，藉兩回合的玄學考驗大鬥法，爭奪兩個直接晉級的名額！本集神秘嘉賓曾經發生過一宗重大的意外，「星祭司」Hannah、「熊孩兒」Baebae、「微笑感應俠」Trevor、「黑貓之眼」BlackCat隔空連結，嘗試測算其事故發生的年齡、原因與影響。第二題的三位嘉賓以不同技藝，為社會默默付出，四位黑先知單憑外表與有限資料，能否測算出各人從事的工作行業？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
再創世紀#35粵PG
programme.desc: 天生故意讓明晞看到澤雨的死訊，但明晞反應冷淡。定垚聽着澤雨的遺言感悲痛，認定是天生派人殺死他。高哲查出天生會將烏托邦計劃賣給彼列後沽空，定垚擔心泡沫爆破會拖垮整個金融體系，說服程凱用超級電池救亡。可惜此舉未能阻止大市跌勢，突然有一神秘資金大手接貨。天生因沽空失利，大發雷霆，明晞意外發現天生藏起來的藥。內幕交易一案天生成功脫罪，隨即計劃啟動新一輪金融泡沫，定垚不忿，誓要找出天生的罪證！

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 我是小廚神-新加坡篇粵普
programme.desc: 4強賽分兩個回合進行，分別以「水果」和「海鮮」作主題，出線的兩位小朋友會晉級總決賽。Tebo在水果戰表現失準，收拾心情後能否重拾信心？Leonika從容不迫、享受煮食過程的態度令評判另眼相看！鬼馬的Joshua喜擺甫士，奉上的精緻甜品「蘋果酥鬆餅」，能否俘虜女評判的心？Onaya遵從家傳食譜做出的海鮮米粉，味道如何？最終哪兩位獲評判張倩敏、楊國基和陳凱琳青睞，進入總決賽？

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵
香港早晨粵 及 交通消息粵

高朋滿座#176粵
programme.desc: 溢及悅的母親王艷群突然回港，但無面目與子女相認，竟暗中偷看他倆的工作情況。她更化名「Mary 姨」，刻意接近溢。溢聽到慶與義的談話後，竟萌生要尋找親生母親的念頭，但悅怒責溢不應如此，兩姊弟竟因此鬧翻。

programme.title: 射鵰英雄傳之鐵血丹心#21粵普PG
programme.desc: 鐵掌幫幫主遭黃蓉羞辱，最終對決時還竟以出恭為名逃跑。拖雷催促郭靖與華箏成親，黃藥師見狀氣極，黃蓉反過來維護郭靖。楊康靠丐幫信物被推舉成新幫主；郭靖黃蓉遇上淨衣派長老，雖懷疑對方圖謀不軌卻仍中邪術被困…

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
食平3D粵
programme.desc: 「豬肉之最」是俗稱「第一刀」的豬頸背，到底它有多矜貴？且看肥媽示範「橙香第一刀」。魚香茄子煲令茄子煮得太腍，浪費其質感，肥媽可令茄子又爽又惹味。肥媽示範「娘惹海鮮醬燒鮫魚」及「老黃瓜花豆煲豬骨湯」。

programme.title: 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 來自選秀節目《魔音女團》的莊子璇、喬美莎、倪樂琳、宋宛穎、倪嘉雯、盧映彤等「星級」藝員參演的微短劇。故事描述Hilary(莊子璇)為了追尋唱跳夢，參加「超級新星」選拔；某天，她於偶然下發現「魔幻百變床褥」的神奇效果，毅然有所決定……

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 有指不少Z世代受中至重度抑鬱情緒困擾，精神科醫生認為這群組多自幼接觸社交媒體，缺乏面對面社交溝通，故較容易產生孤獨感。醫生詳析不同抑鬱程度對生活的影響，如嚴重甚至有自殺風險。近年AI聊天技術興起，抑鬱人士若多與AI傾訴，對病情可有幫助？髖關節骨折患者多為長者，原因與骨質疏鬆相關，也可能引發肺炎、深層靜脈血栓等。骨科醫生提到此症的死亡率偏高，並帶來診治資訊。「睇餸食飯」，德哥示範「鹹菜涼瓜燜腩肉」。

programme.title: 今晚請客粵
programme.desc: 黎諾懿、陳敏之第一晚請客，邀得愛下廚的龔嘉欣到臨。嘉欣不時在網上分享自家食譜，今集亦會展示拿手菜「乾燒大蝦」。諾懿擅長烹調海鮮，要輕鬆去除象拔蚌的內臟與外皮，有何秘訣？將蚌片放入上湯即焯即食，爽口鮮味！只要發揮創意，網紋哈密瓜也可變成可愛「飛天豬」，留意敏之示範。雞蛋看似平凡，卻能煮出千變萬化的滋味。諾懿巧手炮製「黃金蛋絲蝦球」，不單配菜講究，拉蛋絲的步驟亦有竅門！嘉欣另帶來零失敗的「鮮奶燉蛋」。

programme.title: 天梯#7粵
programme.desc: 濟民擔心世章，醫生說世章不會醒來，但新月不停呼喚下世章終醒來，在家人送別下離世，新月始知苗天是思行常說的好叔叔。世亮被販賣假犀角的騙子所騙，除客戶上門投訴，更有大批記者要求世亮交代出售假貨的事。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 姐姐有新的連身裙穿，小丸子大呼不公平，後來更趁姐姐不在時拿來偷穿，結果兩姊妹吵起上來。小丸子去做收音機體操，期間認識到一名自稱忍者後裔的老婦，聽她說完之後，小丸子對忍者產生濃厚興趣。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 太空看似遙不可及，這集「Kids’ Notes」嘉賓卻指日常生活上有不少用品，例如攝影器材和床褥，都啟發自太空科技及相關研究？主持對太空人的生活與飲食充滿好奇，嘉賓提到太空食物盡量都以擠壓技術製作，讓太空人可於無重狀態下進食，亦不會「洩漏」食物。太空人又如何清潔身體及休息補眠？在太空書寫也要有合適工具，他帶來太空筆，並示範水中寫字。另外，嘉賓曾與登月太空人見面聊天，藉此明白到太空人背後所花的努力。

programme.title: 麵包超人粵日
programme.desc: 棉花糖爺爺到處請人吃棉花糖。細菌人與紅精靈，假扮成果Jam叔叔與牛奶妹妹，來騙取棉花糖。細菌人企圖搶奪小朋友的糖果。當路過的ＢＢ超人正要出手阻止時，貓貓忍者也剛巧路過，並且出手對付細菌人。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 利嘉閣地產45 周年真盤源特約：今日有樓睇粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
programme.desc: 大埔有新盤交樓，不過客廳牆身斜了，冷氣機圍欄難以打開，房間開窗時還會刮鉸，如何執修？

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 世界觀粵 及 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵
東張西望粵 及 海馬牌呈獻：魔幻百變床褥粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#18粵
programme.desc: 朱圓圓獲不少富二代追求，外表光鮮亮麗，實際卻過着與外界想像截然不同的生活。圓圓因故需另覓住處，唐芯提議她入住「開心小棧」，希望她透過社交平台宣傳小棧。圓圓發現小棧真正話事人的秘密，藉此向嘉驄提出各種要求。嘉驄苦不堪言，向萬里等人訴苦，詎料……圓圓存心折騰嘉驄，他亦惟有啞忍。其後，圓圓帶嘉驄選購家具時，竟與曾追求她的富二代及其女伴冤家路窄；為保面子，圓圓要求嘉驄假扮男友，嘉驄竟有意想不到的表現……

programme.title: 宏利保險呈獻：夫妻的博弈#23粵PG
programme.desc: 繼威工作上不斷被幸如等人羞辱，憤然辭職。他過檔至其昌麾下，誓要在幸如面前一雪前恥，沒想到於幸如巧妙的推波助瀾下，令繼威反過來得罪了廣告客戶。幸如、家謙查知繼威失業後宅在家中，與雪文關係惡化，更與模特兒Emma搞外遇，遂設計讓雪文捉姦……雪文終推斷出是幸如一直暗中推動一切，令自己不幸，氣煞找幸如攤牌，糾纏間意外令幸如回想起更多當天車禍中失落的記憶……

programme.title: 翻身蜜語#28粵普
programme.desc: 蜜語通過魏妻得知偷聽真相，紀封手持證據與思源對質，婉君報警將其帶走。紀封復職，帶領酒店贏下與寬利的對賭。貞貞被解僱並因竊取商業機密被捕。蜜語獲瑞士洛桑管理學院錄取，紀封支持她追夢，並承諾待其學成歸來…

programme.title: 玄戰粵PG
programme.desc: 自古以來，參透未來、扭轉乾坤的玄妙之術總是令人神往。然而，在流派百家爭鳴的當前，真正洞悉天機的能人，到底身在何方？注入直播元素的新節目《玄戰》，會掀開不一樣的戰幕。節目組廣邀潛藏民間的玄學高手化身「黑先知」，眾人務必通過重重嚴苛關卡，爭奪晉級資格。海選中表現最好五人獲賦以「白先知」身分，並與突圍而出的黑先知開展對壘。這是一場賭上名譽與實力的玄學之戰，究竟誰人可破譯天機、洞悉玄奧，成為「一代先知」？

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之北上睇真D粵
再創世紀#36粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)定垚網上懸紅尋找天生的黑材料，明晞向天生提議收購天蔭來打擊定垚，定垚氣得出手掌摑明晞。天生目睹經過，放下對明晞戒心，明晞乘機引得天生親口承認買兇殺澤雨。警方通緝天生，但天生已畏罪潛逃。小慧故意要永廉教她健身，惹得程凱吃醋。澤雨生忌，程凱與小慧以智能家居的投射影像來悼念澤雨。高哲向定垚辭職，前往加拿大找思妤。定垚亦辭去傲堂主席一職，走到天涯海角，終於找到正在逃亡的天生……

programme.title: Sunday靚聲王粵
programme.desc: 早年劉鳳屏憑其嬌嗲的歌聲征服歌迷的心，被封為「嬌嬌女歌后」，今次回歸TVB舞台，任歌迷點唱，並與Liza姐、秋官，以及愛徒鄧佩儀、梁皓筠同場獻藝。此外，她還大派「福利」，首度於螢幕上獻唱英文歌。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.desc: 動物園可真是個瘋狂的地方！原本不在同一片大陸的動物，如今都在一起共同生活。但對一群好朋友來說，動物園就是他們的家！這裡有活潑好動的大象拉拉、聰明的鱷魚沃比、害羞的白虎咪噗、俏皮的水獺可可子，還有勇敢的鴿子狄爾，快來和我們一起認識這群朋友吧！

programme.title: 能成為陌生人嗎
programme.desc: 【姜素拉化身訴訟女神離婚怨偶再擦出火花】所謂「相愛容易，相處難」，恩範&荷拉已愛情長跑10年、結婚3年，因男方外遇出軌導致離婚收場。專門負責離婚訴訟的明星律師吳荷拉，時常上電視節目，大談如何應對離異後的謠言誹謗、前夫不負責閃避贍養費等問題，對她來說前夫只是「行走的贍養費」。原本自己開設事務所的恩範，因打輸官司被客戶追著跑，窮途末路下找到荷拉就職事務所的代表，簽下聘用合約。面對「最熟悉的陌生人」前夫恩範，荷拉能否做到毫不在意，快樂地過著婚後人生呢？這對歡喜冤家又會擦出什麼火花呢？

programme.title: 殘酷的實習生
programme.desc: 【羅美蘭化身高年級實習生道盡女性職場家庭壓力】曾叱吒職場的女強人高海羅，在為家庭中斷事業七年後，決心重返職場、找回自我價，從主管跌回實習生，她不僅要面對年齡與職場現實的殘酷挑戰，更得直面昔日競爭對手、如今成為上司的崔智媛。在一項充滿道德兩難的任務中，海羅被迫於同為母親的立場與職涯機會之間掙扎。劇情深刻刻畫中年女性在家庭、工作與自我之間的拉扯與重生，以真實而細膩的情感，引發無數職場女性共鳴。

programme.title: 當你沉睡時
programme.desc: 擁有預知夢能力的洪珠，因總是只能夢見未來卻無力改變而讓她痛苦。不是金湯匙出生也沒有優秀的學歷及人脈，卻總是富有充滿正義感的檢察官宰璨。兩人的相遇為了阻止夢境的可怕事件變成現實，開始相信對方是否能成為扭轉未來的人呢?

programme.title: 兩個女人的房間
programme.desc: 【慘遭閨蜜心機暗算朴恩惠由飯店繼承人淪為女僕】在瑞士留學歸來後，晴彩充滿自信地踏入了蒙娜麗莎飯店，端莊秀麗的外表和聰穎的頭腦，讓她很快成為了飯店的副社長兼繼承人。與同飯店的總經理志燮之間的戀情，更是讓她的生活充滿了甜蜜和期待。一場車禍意外將掀起腥風血雨，當晴彩以為自己撞死了熙秀的養父時，內心充滿了恐懼與內疚感，在晴彩的堅持下，熙秀搬進了她的家，開始了新的生活。從那時起，晴彩心愛的人和她的一切都逐漸被熙秀所奪走，包括飯店的地位和財富，晴彩更是從繼承人淪為女僕，為了奪回曾經的一切，晴彩將對熙秀展開復仇。

programme.title: 寵妻明君：李祘
programme.desc: 年幼的李祘目睹了父親死於政治陰謀，又在祖父近乎慘酷的調教下長大，雖然貴為王位繼承人，但政敵始終欲治李祘於死地，這些練就了李祘逆境中處變不驚、不折不撓的品性。宮廷畫苑的畫師韓松淵是李祘的紅粉知己。後來松淵做了李祘的王妃，一直堅定地支持着李祘的治國大業。

programme.title: 少年時代
programme.desc: 【電影《原本以為只是手機掉了》任時完，大反派變小可憐少年，勇往直前成為校園新老大！！】出生忠清南道的瘦小懦弱高中生張秉泰，以「在學校不挨打」為最大目標。某天因父親意外的關係，連夜逃到隔壁村，轉學至扶餘農高竟搖身一變成為學校老大，親身體驗強者生存的熱血故事。

programme.title: 青春時代2
programme.desc: 【《2023韓國百想藝術大賞》得主朴恩斌共住女生宿舍，共度後青春時代！！】居住在ShareHouse的五位大學生，同住一個屋簷又過了一年，迎來了新的室友。臨近大學畢業的日子，求職與愛情的煩惱，五個追著自己期望的事物，繼續寫下屬於她們的青春故事。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 與君歌
programme.desc: 唐文宗末年，宦官擾亂朝政的時代，唐文宗與大臣企圖除去奸佞仇子梁，不幸失敗，造成宰相王訓被滿門抄斬，唯有兩個孫女逃過一劫，姐姐改名為煙織成為仇子梁義女，妹妹改名為程若魚/魚冰兒在紫衣局長大，新皇帝齊焱登基後，利用紫衣局對付仇子梁，也間接使得姐妹兩人針鋒相對，所幸最終程若魚與齊焱剿盪仇子梁成功，待齊焱逝世之後，由珖王李忱繼位，展現重振大唐的決心，勵精圖治。

programme.desc: Rookie is sitting by a pond when he suddenly sees eyes staring at him from the water. Thinking of his friend the crocodile, he first keeps a safe distance, but then realizes that it is a cool frog that jumps out of the water and performs some awesome tricks. Rookie watches and tries to copy, and it doesn’t take too long to master such leaps, the frog being an excellent teacher. And when the frog finally falls, Rookie is fast enough to catch it and save it from harm.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FLY, ROOKIE FLY! ROOKIE AND THE BIRD
programme.desc: Rookie is enjoying a sunny day when he spots a playful little bird drawing circles and shapes in the sky. Inspired to fly, Rookie climbs a tall tree to jump - but after a split second, the only way is down! Quickly, Rookie activates his parachute and lands safely. Although the bird is bursting with laughter, Rookie doesn‘t give u,p and with the help of a giant propeller, he manages to impress his new little friend.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MOOOO WHO? ROOKIE AND THE BLIND COW
programme.desc: On his tour, Rookie discovers a small cow trapped in a pit and unable to escape on its own. He quickly rushes to its rescue and lifts it to safety. After helping the cow, Rookie realizes the cause of her fall: Very poor eyesight! Rookie presses a button, his body buzzing as he generates a pair of glasses. Rookie puts them on the little cow’s nose - and now she can see everything and even manages a high-fi ve to say goodbye before proudly taking off.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - PICTURE THIS! ROOKIE AND THE CAMERA
programme.desc: Rookie stumbles upon a device, picks it up, and as he goes to examine it, it flashes, and an instant picture comes out. Rookie is thrilled and immediately starts taking pictures of his entire surroundings from all sides and in all sorts of positions. Finally, he has a great idea: In his amazing new photo salon set up in a tent, photo artist Rookie will soon be waiting for all his friends to take wonderful portraits of them!

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - BOOKS ARE MAGIC! ROOKIE AND THE LIBRARY
programme.desc: Rookie finds a large library and is fascinated and attracted by all the colorful books. He picks up the first book, but gets frightened when the smiling shark on the cover turns into a ravenous biter after only one page. He chooses another book with a clown’s face and laughs at the funny pictures inside, then one about astronauts and the moon, and another with beautiful landscapes, before he finds an empty, completely white book that gives him a whole new idea.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - DANCE WITH YOUR FRIENDS – ROOKIE THE DJ
programme.desc: On his hike, Rookie discovers a strange, shiny globe hanging from a tree. He gently taps it, and the ball immediately begins to spin, reflecting the light beautifully in all directions: A disco ball! Just behind i, the Rookie finds a DJ booth and soon the music starts and the party begins! Lights are flashing, and all his buddies show up to have a dance with their friends under the sparkling disco ball.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - MY SAND IS MY CASTLE! ROOKIE AND THE CRAB
programme.desc: Rookie enjoys a beautiful day by the sea, playing in the warm sand. He starts to build a sandcastle, which soon gets bigger and bigger soon and notices a crab, which is interested in his building and starts to explore it like his own house. There is a new idea! He presses a button and becomes as small as the little friend, and together they play games inside the sandcastle, before their fun is interrupted by a big wave.

programme.title: Rookie Robot - Rookie Robot - FRIENDS IN THE SKY, FRIENDS FLYING HIGH? ROOKIE AND THE CLOUDS
programme.desc: What could be better than a meadow of flowers on a beautiful day? Rookie is enjoying the sun and the beautiful blue sky, watching the clouds pass by - but wait! What‘s that? One of the clouds turns, and suddenly its shape reminds him of one of his friends! And who is that again? What a fun game to play! Rookie continues to search for clouds that remind him of his friends and their adventures together.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - El castillo de Robins
programme.desc: Como la lente no se puede recuperar, el Dr. No quiere fabricar otra, pero necesita petirrojos para ello. Así que ataca Rubidia, una región repleta de piedras preciosas. Pero Oxin, el rey de Rubidia, lo toma prisionero y lo encierra en el castillo donde también está Chip, ya que Oxin los obliga a trabajar como esclavos en sus minas. El Dr. No intenta convencer a Chip de que le devuelva la lente, pero Chip se niega. Más tarde, ambos logran escapar del castillo y el Dr. No persigue a Chip con su nave. Pero el chico atrapa al científico y también ayuda a liberar a los esclavos de Rubidia.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La trampa de la armonica
programme.desc: Chip y sus amigos crean una zona con formaciones que se asemejan a instrumentos musicales y armonizan sus sonidos. De repente, quedan atrapados en un rectángulo de cristales de cuarzo que vibran al formar una trampa sónica. Un átomo músico, que los ha capturado, busca miembros para formar una orquesta. Los antimateriales están cerca y Chip le pide al músico que prepare la trampa para retenerlos y escapar. El músico acepta y los antimateriales se convierten en prisioneros, obligándolos a escuchar el terrible sonido de sus composiciones.

programme.title: Rookie Robot
programme.desc: Rookie is a curious little robot who loves making friends, discovering new things, and having fun with music, magic, animals, and more. Every day is a new adventure for Rookie—whether he’s chasing a bouncing ball, exploring the stars, or learning how something works. He’s always ready to laugh, try again when things get tricky, and share big smiles with the friends he meets along the way. With Rookie, even the smallest moments become exciting discoveries!

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - Sabotaje
programme.desc: Chip es un niño de 9 años que prefiere jugar con sus compañeros antes de las clases de física y química con su maestra Susan. Un día, durante una visita escolar al Instituto de Alta Energía, un científico loco, el Dr. No, está realizando un experimento con una lente capaz de convertir materia en antimateria, lo que provoca un accidente y un rayo incontrolado que lanza a Chip y al científico a la dimensión del micromundo. Chip se da cuenta de que el accidente lo ha enviado a un lugar desconocido y no sabe cómo regresar. Unos átomos de hierro, mercurio e hidrógeno, representados como Fer, Merc e Hidro, lo guiarán para ayudarlo a encontrar el camino de vuelta. Al mismo tiempo, el Dr. No descubre que, debido al accidente, ha logrado crear antimateria, y el poder que esto le otorga lo prepara para convertirse en el amo del mundo.

programme.title: LMN's - LMN's - La corriente electrica
programme.desc: Fer, Merc e Hidro llevan a Chip a la Ciudad Atómica, donde hay noticias de otro humano, el Dr. No, que ha llegado al micromundo. Chip piensa que tal vez el Dr. No podría ayudarlo a regresar a su dimensión, y va a verlo para devolverle la lente que el científico perdió durante el viaje al micromundo. Pero el Dr. No está construyendo la Torre Negra, una poderosa máquina que lo ayudará a esclavizar a todos los átomos del micromundo. Ahora tiene muchos trabajando bajo sus órdenes, y los lanza contra Chip y sus amigos para convertirlos en prisioneros y arrebatarles la lente. Al escapar, Chip cae en una corriente eléctrica que lo transporta muy lejos.

programme.desc: A suicide bomber gets stuck in a hotel with his intended victims when their flight is cancelled because of a snow storm. Over the next few days, he befriends them and even falls in love. Can he finish his deadly mission when they board the plane again?

programme.desc: As winter sets in and P.A. sees the world shifting around him, he starts to observe strange phenomena in the environment. The changes are imperceptible at first, but gradually his whole world seems to be on the brink.

programme.title: ëlRafa
programme.desc: The true love story of Tunisian Nazir and his pregnant Dutch wife. They are separated when he is denied entry into Holland and so, Nazir attempts the dangerous sea crossing but ends up caught. Against all odds, his wife races across countries to free him.

programme.desc: Based on true events. In WWII's snowy Giant Mountains, a group of children help a French pilot escape by moving him between villages. They face enemy soldiers, traitors, and harsh winter while demonstrating courage and friendship.

programme.title: Easy Living
programme.desc: A 14-year-old kid, a young woman who smuggles medicines up and down the Italian border with France and a bizarre American tennis teacher who dreams of being a painter. Their lives take a turn when they meet an illegal migrant.

programme.title: Glorious Ashes
programme.desc: In the quiet fishing village of Thom Rom, lives drift and collide like tides. Duong endures a loveless marriage shadowed by another woman—Nhan—yet finds solace in her. As bonds form and vengeance stirs, three women navigate love, loss, and survival.

programme.title: Human Capital
programme.desc: Lake Como, Italy. A cyclist is hit off the road by a jeep in the night before Christmas Eve. What happened that night? How will this accident change the destiny of the rich Bernaschi family and the Rovelli family on the edge of bankruptcy?

programme.title: I Have Electric Dreams
programme.desc: 16-year-old Eva is experiencing her sexual awakening and is desperate to leave the house she shares with her mother and younger sister and move in with her estranged father, a troubled artist who paints, sculpts, writes poetry and drinks too much.

programme.title: Walking With Dinosaurs S01 - The Pack
programme.desc: Seventy-one million years ago lived a teenage Albertosaurus - a faster, nimbler relative of T. rex. She had to earn her place in a deadly, ferocious pack or risk starvation. Today, palaeontologists in western Canada are unearthing her remains, allowing us to imagine her story. Based on real-world evidence, stunning VFX recreate her encounters, from hunting pterosaurs to fighting the dominant matriarch and battling for survival in the brutal late Cretaceous world.

programme.title: Uncharted Amazon with Ash Dykes S01 - To the Sea
programme.desc: Ash and the team begin their final push to the ocean, but the journey becomes a brutal test of endurance. On Day 37, they finally reach the Atlantic, completing an extraordinary world‑record expedition.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Close the Gate
programme.desc: The Teletubbies accidentally leave the Tiddlytubbies' gate open and some of them escape into Home Dome. The Teletubbies must find them all and then close the gate.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Peas
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say peas and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. Today, Dee has lots of fun with peas! We see peas on a plate, peas in a pod - and even a pea flying! Peas can be little, yummy and frozen! There's also a funny ant who uses a pea as a bowling ball! The journey is repeated with some special surprises along the way and everyone has a boogie when Dee's friend finally succeeds in saying today's word!

programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Glow Messy
programme.desc: When the OKIDO lighthouse breaks down, Messy, Felix, Zoe and Zoom travel to Mystery Mountain in search of a light that never goes out.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops S01 - Nine Legged Bill
programme.desc: Cap'n Gail's tall tale of a nine-legged octopus in Lake Swoppiton has everyone panicking. But Mojo and Bo wonder: is the story real, or is Cap'n Gail up to something?

programme.title: Bluey S03 - TV Shop
programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Wild Girls
programme.desc: Coco wants to play Wild Girls with Indy, but Chloe wants her to play another game.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge
programme.desc: All the Squirrels are having a fine old time playing with the hose. All except one, poor Tag whose feet hurt. 'Why do my feet hurt?', he asks Duggee. While Duggee has a think, he tells them 'why' is a great question, and the Squirrels are quick to follow up.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Mime Badge
programme.desc: Duggee is encouraging the Squirrels to come outside by gesturing through the window. They don't understand what he's doing and think it's funny. When he comes inside, a bit exasperated, he explains that he was miming. They want to know what miming is, and Duggee fondly recalls his days as a young Parisian street performer. The Squirrels are keen to learn how to mime, and Duggee runs them through the basics.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Ping Pong Penguins
programme.desc: What’s that bouncy, pingy, whacking sound? It’s the Penguins playing ping-pong!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Splash Dash
programme.desc: Duggie chooses a key and his blue digger to dig up a big bone. The chipmunk makes a delivery to the squirrels.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Terracotta Army, China
programme.desc: Ubercorn is DJing a funky party at the Go Jet Academy for the Go Jetters and cadets to enjoy, when suddenly Grandmaster Glitch gatecrashes with his mighty electric guitar. Glitch starts playing rock music with his Grimbots backing him up on the drums. Although Kyan is loving the music, it is LOUD and starts to crack the Academy statues. Ubercorn shuts down Glitch's raucous rock performance leaving the Grandmaster determined to find a brand new crowd who'll love his loud music. He decides to trav

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Zoo
programme.desc: Bluey's backyard zoo is home to wonderful animals, especially the big blue Daddy gorilla. But when he grabs visitor Bingo and escapes, Zookeeper Bluey must recapture the wild beast.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Double Babysitter
programme.desc: When Uncle Rad and Frisky accidentally turn up to babysit Bluey and Bingo on the same night, they have to work together to make Bluey feel better about babysitter putdowns.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Chest
programme.desc: Dad tries to teach Bluey how to play chess, but Mum thinks she is still too young. When Bingo joins in, the kids make up their own rules, but they still can't beat Dad.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Sheep Dog
programme.desc: Dad agrees to play Sheepdog with Bluey and Bingo to stop them from disturbing Mum who is taking a well-earned rest, but looking after a sheep is harder work than they expected.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Mischevous Dino
programme.desc: Andy returns from an adventure to find his sleeping quarters are unusually messy and discovers a small unidentified dinosaur rifling through his things.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Star
programme.desc: Bella and Lift are visited by a shining star and set off to explore the floors of Playtime Towers. The first stop is Sketch in Boxtropolis - what will she be making today?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Pet Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels meet a scruffelump in the woods, and despite Duggee's reservations, take him in. But they soon learn the responsibilities of taking care of a pet.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - The Choreography Badge
programme.desc: The Squirrels are out doing their exercises when suddenly, a cheetah called Chipo comes along with his dance crew. He criticises them for not being able to dance in time, and it turns out Duggee used to be part of the dance crew! Duggee was a great dancer, but he never stuck to the choreography and was always making up his own moves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S04 - Betty's First Day
programme.desc: The Squirrels are having fun playing games but are surprised to find out that Betty didn't always enjoy playing. Since her first day at Squirrel Club, she always impressed everyone with her confidence and independence, but at first she didn't know how to join in with the others. Luckily, Duggee had a great idea to bring all the Squirrels together.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Wieliczka Salt Mine, Poland
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch's digging floods Wieliczka Salt mine. The Go Jetters must save the famous salt statues.

programme.title: Go Jetters S01 - The Forbidden City, China
programme.desc: What is that awful noise coming from the Gulou Tower? It's Grandmaster Glitch dressed up as a Chinese Emperor singing of course! Go Jetters to the rescue!

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S23 - Rangers of the Rails
programme.desc: A bit bored by her surroundings, Emily longs to go on a fun adventure and experience something new and exciting. It's not long before her wish is granted.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Woolly Memories
programme.desc: Scarf Lady's old film reels get themselves in a tangle, so Sarah and Duck decide to recreate the footage.

programme.title: Sarah and Duck S02 - Beach Break
programme.desc: Sarah and Duck are spending a day at the beach, aiming to build some sand animals.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Bug Hotel
programme.desc: Benjamin and Sophie have a new bug friend. Stanley helps build a bug feeder which attracts lots more bugs. They eat so much; Stanley gets more food and builds a Bug Hotel for them.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Recycling
programme.desc: Fred, Fifi and Ari call Stanley to help them with their recycling drive by coming up with a way of repurposing all the towns' old stuff. Stanley makes a crazy golf course!

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I Like Tractors
programme.desc: From riding cows to having pigs in the house, the funny animals chat about everything brilliant about farms.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S03 - It's Time To Look For Frogs

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Night And Day

programme.desc: The Go Jetters arrive at the Bonneville Salt Flats in Utah, USA - a huge dry lakebed that's perfect for high-speed driving. He once lost a race to the current record holder, Ubercorn, and now he's back for a second go.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Tomato
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits Theatre, Tomato changes colour.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S01 - Raspberry

programme.title: Supertato S02 - A Clean Getaway
programme.desc: Supertato and Tomato find themselves stuck in a slippery bathtub, whilst Evil Pea rampages around the supermarket on a giant soap-squirting machine.

programme.title: Supertato S02 - Super Sandcastle
programme.desc: Supertato and the Veggies have built a super sandcastle, but Evil Pea wants to storm it by firing her hordes of Mini Peas at it with her pea shooter.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Trailer
programme.desc: When it's time for the Tubby Custard Ride, there's a special trailer the Teletubbies haven't seen before. It's for The Noo-­Noo who gets to go on a special Tubby Custard Ride.

programme.title: Yakka Dee S01 - Hat
programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say hat and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see lots of different hats - a small hat, a big hat - even a wooly pink pig hat! programme.title: Messy goes to OKIDO S02 - Vote Okido

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Slide
programme.desc: Bingo and Lila are excited to play on their new waterslide.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - TV Shop
programme.desc: At the chemist, Bluey and Bingo have fun playing with the CCTV screens.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Sibling Badge

The Squirrels have all sorts of questions to ask.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Why Badge

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Panama Canal, Panama
programme.desc: Grandmaster Glitch is late for the European Moustache of the Year award ceremony, and even worse, he's broken down! The Grimbots are on hand to recommend a shortcut: the Panama Canal, a man-made passage that provides a gateway between the Pacific and Atlantic oceans. Meanwhile, the Go Jetters are also heading to the Panama Canal to see its huge watery steps in action, but they arrive to find honking ships' horns and a huge traffic jam - it's all been glitched!

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Backpackers

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Picnic
programme.desc: The Teletubbies go on a very special picnic together. Lots of Tubby Toast pops out of the Dup Dup and lands on the picnic plates for the Teletubbies to munch.

programme.title: That Fiery Girl
programme.desc: The bandits of Hulu Valley slay the chief of the Mei Clan while searching for a treasure map. In retaliation, Chun from the Mei Clan infiltrates the bandit's fortress to map a way in for the authorities, but ends up falling in love with the bandit leader's daughter, Pearl. While Chun's plot is uncovered, he receives unexpected help from Pearl.

programme.title: Twinkle Twinkle Little Star
programme.desc: A beautiful but ignorant woman is abducted by aliens but nobody believes her close encounter. While planning a suicide to prove herself, she meets a failed detective who is also planning his suicide. They change their minds about dying after finding each other and start to encounter bizarre adventures, before falling in love with each other.

programme.title: Return of Reincarnated Swordsman
programme.desc: A band of ninjas slaughters the entire Wu Dang Clan and frames Du Gu Wu Di, chief of the Invincible Clan, for the deed. Yun masters the silkworm martial arts style and decides to take revenge for the Clan by challenging Wu Di, but is defeated and seriously hurt. Luckily, Master Li saves and treats him, allowing Yun to avoid the ninjas' pursuit.

programme.title: The Adulteress
programme.desc: The film is about the drugged, then disgraced wife of a peddler in the waning days of the Ching Dynasty. To make matters worse, she's soon framed for her husband's murder by her rapist, the son of the local magistrate! And even that is not the end of her woes in this emotional suspense…

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: Disciples of the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: In the finale of this trilogy, Gordon Liu reprises his famous role, Monk San Te, as he tries to protect Fang Shih Yu, an arrogant youth who gets into trouble with the Qing officials, and nearly lands Shaolin Temple into trouble too.

programme.title: Men From The Gutter
programme.desc: Two very different cops are out to capture a local drug boss. In this sizzling crime thriller, the two cops go about doing their jobs differently - one does everything to the letter of the law and the other just doing whatever it takes to solve crime.

programme.title: The Emperor and his Brother
programme.desc: The Emperor Qianlong is not the legitimate successor to the throne at birth, but he only learns the truth when two senior members of a subversive anti-government secret organisation contact him years later. As it happens, the chef of this organisation is Qianlong's younger brother and they must now confront each other in opposing roles…

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: Holy Flame of the Martial World
programme.desc: Yin Tian Chou's parents were killed over a pair of flame-shaped blades. He and his sister were rescued, raised, and trained separately by a hero and a villain, each inheriting one of the blades. Sworn enemies at first, they eventually uncover their true identities and join forces to avenge their parents' deaths.

programme.title: The Perfumed Arrow
programme.desc: A charming Huangmei Opera title, this is the story of Fei E, a General's daughter who grows up fooling everyone that she is a boy, including her two closest schoolmates. When she has to choose one of them to marry, how will Fei E tell them that she is a girl? To complicate matters, a girl who Fei E saves one day only wants to be married to her!

programme.title: The Spirit of the Sword
programme.desc: Water Clan Chief is severely wounded by a samurai killer shortly before the annual duel at Tai Lake. He sends his brother Bao Yu on a long journey to find an antidote for him. On the way, Bao Yu encounters Little Princess and falls in love with her, not knowing that she is hiding a secret plot…

programme.title: The Adventures of Emperor Chien Lung
programme.desc: Emperor Chien Lung travels incognito to Jiangnan to review his people's livelihood but soon discovers that corrupt officials are oppressing his people. The emperor meets an upright young man and they join hands to teach the corrupt officials a lesson. The young man was appointed as his bodyguard thereafter.

programme.title: The Deadly Duo
programme.desc: The prince of the Sung Dynasty is captured by the Chin invaders and guarded by top martial arts masters. Two powerful patriots need to fight the overwhelming odds and pull off the impossible: to rescue the royal Prince and get out of the Chin stronghold alive.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: When the Clouds Roll By
programme.desc: Su is a schizophrenic who refuses to believe that her pilot lover is killed in a plane crash and makes up stories to deal with things. She runs into an old classmate Lai, who is also a doctor one day, and he finds ways to treat her illness. Su slowly recovers and accepts the reality, as well as her newfound love.

programme.title: The Daredevils
programme.desc: Corrupt general Wang Li assumes power by killing his superior. The son of the murdered superior befriends four street performers called “The Venoms”, and they help him take revenge by posing as government officials offering a peace token to the corrupt general. When Wang arrives at a warehouse, he is ambushed by the Venoms!

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: The Human Goddess
programme.desc: Seventh Sister, a curious fairy from heaven, descends to 1970s Hong Kong. Lost in an unfamiliar world, she is rescued by Tung Chi Lap, who runs a debt-ridden orphanage. When a tycoon plots to seize the land, she uses her powers to protect it, and an unlikely romance begins.

programme.title: The Vengeful Beauty
programme.desc: The Flying Guillotine assassins are secretly working for the Emperor and its leader Jin is sent to kill Hon, who knows this secret. Hon's pregnant wife Rong seeks to kill Jin but retreats to protect her unborn child. When she is hunted down herself, Rong hooks up with a former Flying Guillotine member and her martial arts senior to fight back...

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: One-armed Swordsman Fang Kang wants to lead a quiet life with his wife, but when she is abducted by the Eight Demon Swordsmen clan, he is forced to take them on in order to save her.

programme.title: Hong Kong Rhapsody
programme.desc: Hong Kong rhapsody is a musical extravaganza full of song and dance! Peter Chen-Ho stars as a playboy magician who changes his ways after he becomes the guardian of a young singer (Li Ching), the daughter of a deceased magician friend.

programme.title: Five Superfighters
programme.desc: A kung fu master and his three students lost everything after they are floored by a bully. To take revenge, the students find ways to learn from other kung fu masters and come back six months later to have a rematch with the bully on their master's birthday.

programme.title: Beyond the Great Wall
programme.desc: Wang Zhao Jun refuses to bribe the imperial painter, so he draws an ugly portrait of her, preventing her from being selected by the Emperor until they meet in person. The painter ends up in exile and plots for Wang to marry the Hun's warlord as a revenge. The Emperor rejects this, provoking a war which is only averted when Wang sacrifices herself.

programme.title: King Cat
programme.desc: The son of the imperial teacher is beheaded by Justice Bao for corruption. Infuriated, the teacher hires assassins to kill Bao, who is saved by Zhan Zhao. Meanwhile, a royal treasure is stolen while a murder takes place. Bao is ordered to solve the case in ten days and Zhan quickly sets off to investigate. Will they solve the case in time?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Fastest Sword
programme.desc: Southern Swordsman Ting is named “The Fastest Sword” but is defeated by a street monk and has to fulfil his promise of working on stone craving with the monk for three years. Ting returns home to lead a peaceful life after that and declines all fight challenges. Even so, he is forced to fight the Northern Swordsman. Who will win finally?

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: A young singer Hsiao Yun becomes an overnight sensation after standing in for another singer at the eleventh hour. Her success comes at a heavy price however, when her love with a pianist suffers. On top of this, Hsiao Yun must also deal with the unwanted affections from an influential backer of her show.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: The Sword And The Lute
programme.desc: Gui Wu and his bride use the deadly weapon - Phoenix Lute to fight against evil, but the lute accidentally falls into the hands of bandits hoping to use it to take control of the province. Gui Wu must now fight to recover the lute and beat the bandits.

programme.title: Illicit Desire
programme.desc: This instant cult classic adapts three erotic and mystical tales from the Chinese classical works, with stories spanning across time from the Tang to Ming dynasties. The stories, filled with characters such as emperors, concubines, monks and fortune-tellers, intertwine in a world of adultery, lust and greed, alongside great costumes!

programme.title: The Dragon Creek
programme.desc: This wuxia murder mystery film talks about a young girl whose father was ruthlessly murdered during China's early republican era. She has a list of villains who have been plotting against her father and together with her elder brother, the young girl sets out on a journey to hunt down the secret serial killer.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Master Chen was an esteemed Monkey Kung Fu master, until he is framed and crippled by a ruthless villain and ends up becoming a wandering artiste. When Chen meets a young man, Little Monkey, on the streets, he decides to teach him all his monkey kung fu moves. Both men eventually team up to avenge Chen's past insult.

programme.title: Shaolin Rescuers
programme.desc: Hong Xi Guan of Shaolin is chased and wounded by a martial arts scum who took refuge in the Qing court. He is saved and healed by friends from the wet market and they hide Hong in a bean curd shop to protect him. However, Hong's enemy finds him and ambushes him at the shop, hoping to capture Hong and all his friends.

programme.title: The Young Avenger
programme.desc: Liu seeks out Li to avenge his brother's death and loses an arm in the fight, vowing revenge ten years later. Li dies after asking his sister to send his daughter Bao Zhu to learn the Dragon Sword skill to avenge his death. Bao Zhu grows up to become a skilled swordswoman and meets Liu for the planned duel with her cousin Chen. Can she defeat Liu?

programme.title: Hex after Hex
programme.desc: Hell may have no fury like a woman scorned, but hell literally, really has no wrath like a lusting ghost scorned! Cult classic director Kuei Chih-hung shoots the works with this amazing horror romance starring muscular "Venom" Lo Meng.

programme.title: The Golden Seal
programme.desc: Dai Tian Chou practices martial arts since young so he can avenge his father's death. He meets Wu Xiao Yan who is disguised as a man one day and is suddenly beaten by a group of gangsters. Wu begs her father to allow her to take Dai back home to recover. Little does Dai know this is his chance to take revenge.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao was once defeated by Long in a duel. 7 years later, Long asks Zhao to make a unique lantern on his behalf to win the lantern contest, while Zhao plans for revenge. When Long's wife suddenly disappears one day and he hears about the story of human lanterns, Long suspects Zhao may be involved in the incident…

programme.title: House of Traps
programme.desc: An evil prince has hidden the stolen imperial treasures in a house filled with booby-trapped blades. Amid plasma-spurting attacks, heroes and rogues try to uncover the deadly secrets of the house...

programme.title: Young Lovers
programme.desc: Guitar-playing rich kid, Yang Fan, heads to Japan to join a rock 'n' roll band where he soon finds himself competing for the affections of two beautiful girls.

programme.title: Return to the 36th Chamber
programme.desc: The second film of the trilogy, Gordon Liu plays Zhou Ren Jie, a man who impersonates a monk in order to learn kung fu in Shaolin, and eventually creates his own Shaolin style of ‘scaffolding kung fu”.

programme.title: Dawn will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai drugged the beautiful Qiu Rong and raped her, but promised to marry her after getting his parent's consent. Since then, there is no news of his proposal and Qiu Rong confronts Liang Cai when she finds herself pregnant. This is when she discovers that he has already married a rich noble girl and even plans to kill her…

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu Da Jiang, a naive young man, is betrayed and hunted by his sworn brothers after a gold robbery goes wrong. Surviving against the odds, he gains the favour of a gang leader and embarks on a path of revenge with bodyguard Jin Yan. As rival gangs clash and feelings emerge, a violent underworld showdown becomes inevitable.

programme.title: The 82 Tenants
programme.desc: Continuing the success of the classic comedy “House of 72 tenants”, this sequel tells the stories of tenants living in an old building in Hong Kong who are forced to evict by the developers. Some tenants prefer to take the compensation while some resist the move. Will the acquisitions plan destroy the harmony of the neighborhood?
